_comment: Golden retrieval eval set (M50, D19). Consumed by src/lib/knowledge/eval.ts::runEval and tests/unit/knowledgeEval.test.ts. `in-corpus` items name the expected top-source id (a registry/allowlist id under data/knowledge/registry.json); the pipeline must return that source at/above RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD. `out-of-corpus` items must return noSourceFound. Pass-bar (EVAL_PASS_BAR): in-corpus top-source accuracy >= 0.90, out-of-corpus no-source rate = 1.0. Frozen here, re-audited in M55.
